object_description: three distinct volumes forming a solids-and-voids composition
design_condition: The three volumes follow the site geometry, integrate the existing building, and define a sequence of outdoor spaces including a forecourt, college square, green space, and sports areas.

positive.statement: The implementation concept successfully integrates existing buildings and developments.
The college square provides a well-defined reference space for the new college.
The distribution into three volumes allows great flexibility of use.
The refectory and aula building and the gymnasium rooms are organized in a clear and functional manner.

negative.statement: The duplicated pedestrian traffic considerably weakens the concept of the project implementation.
The typology and organization of the main classroom building are not convincing, particularly because orientation is difficult on the ground floor.
The central courtyard should have been more generous and perhaps extended over the entire height of the building.
Some spaces around the central courtyard are in second daylight and lack natural light and ventilation.
The circulation around the courtyard leaves little possibility of informal appropriation for users.
